items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
Advanced degree in public policy, higher education, business administration, or related field.

Experience with UC and UC Davis organization, units, resources, facilities, and student information systems including Graduate Studies managed applications systems such as Program and Roles Manager (PRM), Programs Manager, Student Progress Assessment (SPA), etc.

Experience leading teams with project management paradigms (e.g. Lean SixSigma, Agile, Scrum, Kanban) and their implementation with collaborative software tools (e.g. JIRA, SmartSheet, Trello, Asana, BaseCamp, etc)

Reporting to the Executive Director of Analysis, Policy & Technology, the Director of Policy & Program Initiatives is responsible for leading and managing a team to support campus governance of higher education and essential program services. The Director oversees complex analyses and initiatives related to graduate and professional education, providing campus leadership, administrative units, and Graduate Studies with a resource for policy interpretation, communication, and development. The Director is also responsible for managing the GradSphere business process management platform. In this role, the Director develops plans and oversees the implementation of a business system that achieves organizational objectives around efficiency, policy compliance, and other goals in support of the Graduate Studies mission. The Director supervises three full-time direct reports, managing professional staff to accomplish unit plans and objectives and contributing to the overall leadership of Graduate Studies. Develops project plans and staffing needs to complete research, projects, initiatives, and other activities. Reviews work and provides guidance to staff to achieve goals within established policies. Determines long-term and short-term strategic plans to achieve objectives on behalf of Graduate Studies and campus. The Director serves as the primary liaison to Academic Senate/Graduate Council for shared governance of graduate education. Assists in planning, development ,implementation and administration of establishing new graduate programs and other program changes. Applies in depth understanding to a broad range of policies and issues relating to graduate education and postdoctoral scholars, helping Graduate Studies leadership and staff, program faculty, graduate students and postdocs to resolve problems that are complex in nature and diverse in scope. Conducts research and analysis on a wide variety of topics in support of new initiatives, and communicates findings in a variety of formats including reports, web-hosted data, presentations, and special projects. #CA-AR
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to communicate with leadership, and lead and direct reports.
Knowledge of campus policies of higher education.
Thorough knowledge of organization processes, protocols, research and procedures.
Extensive analytical / problem-solving and project management skills.
